steps.text: From the level 2 bridge, head north into the main Rookgaard cave and go down.
steps.source: From the level 2 bridge, head north to the main Rookgaard cave (Mapper Coords 125.95, 125.138, 7).

steps.text: Follow the cave east (a rat, trolls) to the ladder going down.
steps.source: On the -1 floor, expect to find a rat, a few trolls and maybe some spiders. Follow through the cave to the east until you reach a ladder going down.

steps.text: Head north (an orc), north-east at the first crossing and north-west at the second, to the next ladder down.
steps.source: On the second underground floor (-2) you may find one or two orcs. Head north, follow the first cross-section north-east, and second north-west until you reach another ladder.

steps.text: The wolf maze: follow the path north through the wolves and an orc to the next ladder down.
steps.source: Descend to the third underground floor and you will be in the Wolf maze. Follow the path north through the masses of wolves and orcs to yet another ladder.

steps.text: Minotaur Hell: minotaurs, orcs and wolves. Clear the floor and go down the stairs to the minotaurs in the quest room.
steps.source: When going down the ladder, there will be about 2 minotaurs, 8 orcs and some wolves. Once the floor is cleared you can go down the staircase to the final room.

steps.text: The three quest boxes are west of the stairs on the south wall: the carlin sword,
steps.source: Once the room has been cleared, the three quest boxes are just to the west of the stairs, on the south walls of the cave.

steps.text: a bag with 10 arrows and 4 poison arrows,
steps.source: The bag contains 10 Arrows and 4 Poison Arrows.
The quest room and its rewards.
